title: A quadratic speed bound for two-entry Lonely Runner modifications
description: Answers the polynomial-bound alternative in Yuhan Zhang’s Question 8.2 for two replacements: for n at least 5, every configuration with loneliness at most 1/n has maximum speed at most 130(n−1)^2. Also classifies the case in which one deleted speed is 1: only the scaled consecutive set {2,4,6,8} at n=5. The full Lonely Runner Conjecture and modifications of three or more entries remain open. AI-assisted and internally checked.
